story_description: Install compiled hooks into Claude Code, manage scope, and visualize active hooks.
task_description: Users need a lifecycle management tool to install, enable, disable, and scope hooks so they do not rebuild existing automation and can control where hooks live.
atom_description: Users need a lifecycle management tool to install, enable, disable, and scope hooks so they do not rebuild existing automation and can control where hooks live.
problem_statement: Users need a lifecycle management tool to install, enable, disable, and scope hooks so they do not rebuild existing automation and can control where hooks live.
scope_in: List all installed hooks, show scope and status, enable/disable, uninstall, choose default install scope
Implement HooksLifecycleView.swift according to the problem statement and functional requirements.
scope_out: Visual canvas editing (handled by HooksBuilderView and related atoms)
Exclude work assigned to other atoms or features in this epic.
assumptions: HooksInstallationService can read and write hooks.json
Hook summaries can be derived from compiled hooks.json
Blaze app builds successfully with `swift build` before work begins
@AppStorage is the persistence mechanism for user preferences
Actor-based stores (HookStore pattern) are the standard for data persistence
constraints: Must support both user and project scopes
Must show conflicts when the same hook exists in both scopes
Must not block the main UI thread
Must not block main UI thread
Must use glass styling via DSGlass for all settings panels
Must support keyboard navigation (accessibility)
Must persist state across app restarts
All user-facing strings must be localizable (use String constants)
No third-party dependencies without explicit approval
At least one event node per graph
UpdatedInput only under PreToolUse or PermissionRequest with allow
Stop gate only under Stop or SubagentStop with loop safety
Conflict resolution: continue false wins, deny beats allow, ask beats allow, PostToolUse block forces remediation
Exit 0 success, stdout visible in verbose; UserPromptSubmit and SessionStart may inject into context
Exit 2 blocks with error handling per event
Other exit codes are non-blocking and continue execution
Event nodes: PreToolUse, PostToolUse, PostToolUseFailure, PermissionRequest, UserPromptSubmit, Notification, Stop, SubagentStart, SubagentStop, PreCompact, SessionStart, SessionEnd
Filter nodes: Matcher and Predicate
Action nodes: Command, Prompt, Agent
Control nodes: Decision Allow Deny Ask, Permission Decision, Block with Reason, Continue or Stop
Transformation nodes: Updated Input, Additional Context, System Message
Utility nodes: Logger, Export Trace, Rate limit or Debounce
Left panel node palette with Events, Filters, Actions, Utilities
Center panel canvas with pan, zoom, and grid background
Right panel inspector with node properties, tooltips, and validation errors
Top bar actions: Back, Save, Discard, Test run, Export
Space plus drag to pan canvas
Cmd plus scroll to zoom
Cmd C and Cmd V to copy and paste nodes
Delete to remove node
Cmd S to save, Cmd Enter to test run, Cmd Z to undo, Cmd Shift Z to redo
Cmd I to focus inspector, M to toggle minimap
functional_requirements: Display a list of all installed hooks from user and project scopes
Show scope, event name, matcher, and enabled status
Allow toggling enable/disable and persist changes
Allow uninstall per scope with confirmation
Allow setting default install scope for new hooks
Provide entry point to the lifecycle map view
Support all hook events: PreToolUse, PostToolUse, PostToolUseFailure, PermissionRequest, UserPromptSubmit, Notification, Stop, SubagentStart, SubagentStop, PreCompact, SessionStart, SessionEnd.
Support node taxonomy for events, filters, actions, control, transformation, and utility nodes.
Persist graph with nodes and edges and validate against semantic rules.
nonfunctional_requirements: List refresh completes in under 200ms for 100 hooks
implementation_steps: Create `HooksLifecycleView.swift` with list, filters, and scope selector
Add scope picker: User and Project
Add list rows with enable toggle and uninstall button
Add refresh button and status banner
Add link to lifecycle map view
api_contracts: `refreshInstalledHooks()` -> updates list from user and project scopes
`setDefaultScope(scope:)` -> persists user choice for new installs
ui_states: Loaded: Hooks list with counts by scope
Error: Failed to load hooks.json with retry option
Idle saved state with no unsaved changes
Dirty state with unsaved changes and save enabled
Validating state during schema and semantic checks
Error state with validation errors and save disabled
Saving and Saved states with success toast
Discard confirm modal when leaving with unsaved changes
ui_interactions: Change default scope -> new installs use that scope
Tap map button -> open lifecycle map view
Drag nodes from palette to canvas and connect ports to create edges.
Select node to edit config in inspector with tooltips and examples.
Run test execution and display validation results.
ui_copy: Empty: "No hooks installed. Create one in the builder."
Top bar buttons: Back, Save, Discard, Test run, Export.
Inspector shows short tooltip and long learn more text for each node.
edge_cases: Same hook ID in user and project scopes - show conflict badge
Uninstall user hooks while project hooks exist - list remains accurate
Hooks list larger than viewport - scrolling remains smooth
failure_modes: Parse error in hooks.json - show error banner and skip invalid entries
Toggle fails to persist - revert UI state and show warning
rollback_plan: Remove view and manage hooks via JSON only

unit: Merge user and project hooks with correct scope labels
Unit test core logic for HooksLifecycleView.swift with representative inputs.
integration: Toggle enable updates hooks.json and reloads list
Integration test HooksLifecycleView.swift with dependent stores or managers.
ui: Verify empty, loaded, and error states
Verify SwiftUI previews render without crash.
security: Do not log hook command contents
Ensure no sensitive data is logged.

log_expectations: INFO: Hooks list refreshed with [count] entries
WARN: Failed to parse hooks.json at [path]
acceptance_tests: Toggle a hook -> file updates and list reflects change
Change default scope -> persist and reload
acceptance_criteria: Hooks list shows user and project hooks with scopes
Default scope selection is persisted and used for new installs
completed_when: All definition of done criteria are met and verification steps pass.
completed_evidence: Passing tests, verification steps completed, and artifact outputs present.
open_questions: No open questions; specification is complete for this atom.
verification_steps: Toggle a hook -> file updates and list reflects change
Change default scope -> persist and reload

risks: Large hook lists may impact scroll performance
mitigations: Use lazy stacks and stable IDs
risk_register.fallback_plan: Simplify list to basic text rows

apis: `refreshInstalledHooks()` -> updates list from user and project scopes
`setDefaultScope(scope:)` -> persists user choice for new installs
persistence: Hooks graphs persist as graph.json and compiled hooks.json in the hooks storage path.
